title: Chapter 111: The Underground War
content:
Chapter 111: The Underground War

The movement of the Zerg soon attracted the attention of the ghouls. After a while, a large number of ghouls ran over from the other side of the passage.

They were on all fours, running like the wind, very fast.

Wu Qing's clone stood at the front of the team with a bow and arrow in hand. In front of him was a straight passage, and the ghouls rushed out from the distant bend.

Wu Qing personally led the troops to fight this time to experience the strength and characteristics of the ghouls. There was a big difference between his feelings when he possessed the Zerg and used his clone. The senses of the Zerg were different from those of the human race.

He drew his bow and shot an arrow at the heart of a running ghoul. The ghoul fell to the ground and rolled, then got up and continued to charge.

"This is not a vital point. Their physique is also very amazing!"

Wu Qing did not pause. He shot several times in a row, hitting different vital parts of several ghouls.

Except for the ghoul that was shot through the eye and head by an arrow, which fell to the ground and disappeared, the other ghouls that were shot by arrows were only injured but not dead, showing strong vitality.

"The head of the ghoul is the weakest part. Attacking the head or beheading it should be the most effective way of attack!"

Wu Qing asked the Queen of the Worm to record the conclusion he came to. The Zerg actually did not need Wu Qing to do this. As long as the races that had fought with the Zerg, the Zerg would summarize their experiences and lessons and record the advantages and disadvantages of the enemy.

Moreover, the Zerg has rich combat experience. They only need to take a look at many enemies to know how to fight efficiently. This is a combat instinct.

The reason why Wu Qing did this was mainly because he took into account that the new army formed by the Great Xia leader would definitely encounter various enemies in the future. Now he asked the Queen of the Worm to record more information about various strange creatures in this world in his way for future use.

The large army of ghouls has rushed over. The Zerg Guards and one-star Hydralisks around Wu Qing, who have been upgraded to one star, began to attack the ghouls.

Wu Qing, the Zerg Guards, and the one-star Hydralisk team fired arrows and spikes that were like bullets with eyes. All the ghouls that rushed over were shot in the head and disappeared.

Wu Qing and his team stood to fight the ghouls. Due to the limitation of space, the ghouls tried their best but couldn't rush through.

Ghouls are intelligent and organized creatures. Seeing that they couldn't rush through, they retreated and began to dig holes in the passage.

Before long, the walls of this tall and spacious passage were covered with temporary small passages that could only accommodate one ghoul.

These small passages led to nowhere.

Wu Qing led the Zerg army to continue to move forward, and saw such a scene.

"Among these ghouls, there are highly intelligent commanders, and there may be individuals of huge size."

Wu Qing had to sigh that the advantages of the Zerg's long-range attack arms were offset by the ghouls.

As the Zerg army continued to advance, the ghouls began to use the small holes on the wall of the passage to rush out suddenly and launch sneak attacks.

This tactic may be very effective for ordinary armies, but it has no effect on the Zerg army.

The small passage dug temporarily by the ghouls can only allow one ghoul to pass through at a time. The speed of deploying troops is too slow, and they will be surrounded and killed by the Zerg puppies when they rush out.

Even if the ghouls rush to the side of the long-range hydralisk, the hydralisk with a taller body, with its strong and powerful forelimbs, will hit the face with a spike headshot, a perfect hug kill!

When they rushed to Wu Qing and the Zerg guards, they were also shot in the head.

After losing a group of ghouls, those ghouls learned to be smart again. They no longer raided directly through the temporary small passage, but sent a large number of ghouls to attack from behind through the small passage, launching an attack from the rear of the Zerg army.

Wu Qing had been prepared for this move. In the underground passage, it was impossible to only focus on the front and not the back. There were also several hydralisks led by one-star hydralisks behind the Zerg army.

The rushing ghouls were also subjected to intensive long-range attacks, and it was very difficult to get close.

The ghouls blocked the front and chased the back, and raided in the middle. Various tactics were used at the same time, making the 5,000 Zerg army busy, and the passage was full of fighting sounds.

Because the dead ghouls would disappear in light, they couldn't use their bodies to block the Zerg from advancing.

This large passage was very solid, and it was difficult to collapse it. Wu Qing thought that if the ghouls wanted to do it, they would definitely be able to do it, but for some reason, the ghouls didn't do it.

Although the Zerg had a strong ability to drill the ground, and the Zerg clone was also a Zerg, they were not afraid of being blocked and buried in this underground space, but having a ready-made passage would definitely save a lot of time.

Wu Qing was also happy with this.

After the Zerg army left the Zerg territory for a certain distance, Wu Qing sent out a second Zerg army of 5,000, which followed the first Zerg army at a certain distance.

Wu Qing led the Zerg army, fighting and killing all the way, and finally walked out of the long passage and entered a huge underground space.

This place is like a super underground cave, with only a very weak light.

As soon as Wu Qing stepped into this space, several black things flew over.

A huge shield instantly formed on Wu Qing's left hand, covering his whole body. The Zerg guards around him also transformed into shields, protecting all the Zerg troops behind him.

Try not to get anything on you that is unknown.

Those clumps of stuff were a kind of sticky unknown liquid, which was blocked by the shield transformed by the biological colonization suit. It made a sizzling sound when it fell on the ground, which showed its strong corrosive ability.

If it was directly stuck on the body, the result would definitely not be good.

A host came to the front, and through its super strong perception ability, it found that the entire underground space was full of densely packed ghouls, and there was also a kind of giant ghoul, which looked similar to ordinary ghouls, but with a big belly.

The black corrosive liquid just now was sprayed by them.

"This is a ghoul's nest!"

Wu Qing immediately ordered more Zerg combat troops to come to support.

There are tens of thousands of ghouls gathered here, and there are also many giant ghouls that spray corrosive liquids for long-range attacks. If you want to destroy them, the 10,000 Zergs that entered the underground passage are far from enough.

"Queen of Insects, you should collect information, we will charge in first!"

Wu Qing held up his shield and led the Zerg army to charge in the direction where there were relatively few ghouls. He held a shield in one hand and a sword in the other. Every time he charged, he could knock away a bunch of ghouls that were charging at him, and every time he slashed with his sword, he could cut off the head of a ghoul.

After the strength of the Zerg clone was upgraded to one star, Wu Qing was able to exert a stronger combat power. Facing ghouls whose strength was not as good as that of puppies, he was invincible!
